WEEKLY tier: the pipeline's own weekly gate no-ops runs until the last build is >= 6 calendar days old (--force and --code bypass). DECOUPLED from the analysis_signals rule tier. Incremental: the engine re-decides the full candidate set and rewrites each code's revisable tail (the frontier unit's placement can upgrade forward as bars arrive); the trail ends 2 bars before the bars frontier (the coverage check accounts for it).
